name: Slow Cooker Favorites
description: A dependable collection of classic slow-cooker comfort food, family dinners, soups, sandwiches, pasta, and original flavor-forward creations.

recipes.name: Mississippi Pot Roast

ingredients.item: au jus or brown gravy seasoning mix

instructions: Pat the roast dry and season it with black pepper. Place it in the slow cooker.
Sprinkle the Ranch Seasoning Mix and gravy seasoning evenly over the roast.
Add the pepperoncini and brine, then place the butter on top.
Cover and cook on low for 8–10 hours or high for 5–6 hours, until the beef is fork-tender.
Shred or slice the beef and stir it through the cooking juices before serving.
recipes.description: Fork-tender chuck roast slowly cooked with ranch seasoning, savory gravy seasoning, pepperoncini, and butter.
recipes.notes: The seasoning mixes and pepperoncini are salty, so do not add extra salt until after cooking.

recipes.name: Classic Pot Roast with Vegetables

ingredients.item: Yukon Gold potatoes, cut into large pieces

instructions: Season the roast with salt and pepper. Brown it in the oil in a hot skillet for 3–4 minutes per side, then transfer to the slow cooker.
Arrange the potatoes, carrots, onion, and garlic around the roast.
Whisk the broth, Worcestershire, tomato paste, thyme, and rosemary and pour into the cooker.
Cover and cook on low for 8–10 hours or high for 5–6 hours, until the beef and vegetables are tender.
Transfer the meat and vegetables to a platter. Stir together the cornstarch and cold water, add it to the juices, and cook on high for 10–15 minutes, until thickened.
recipes.description: A traditional chuck roast cooked with potatoes, carrots, onion, herbs, and rich beef gravy.

recipes.name: Beef Tips with Mushroom Gravy

ingredients.item: beef stew meat or sirloin tips

instructions: Brown the beef in oil in batches, then transfer it to the slow cooker.
Add the onion, mushrooms, garlic, broth, Worcestershire, tomato paste, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Cover and cook on low for 7–8 hours or high for 4–5 hours, until the beef is tender.
Whisk the cornstarch with cold water and stir it into the cooker.
Cover and cook on high for 15–20 minutes, until the gravy thickens.
recipes.description: Tender beef tips and mushrooms simmered in a deeply savory gravy for serving over noodles, rice, or potatoes.

recipes.name: Slow Cooker Beef and Broccoli

ingredients.item: beef chuck roast or flank steak, thinly sliced

instructions: Place the beef in the slow cooker.
Whisk the broth, soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, garlic, and ginger and pour over the beef.
Cover and cook on low for 5–6 hours or high for 3–4 hours, until the beef is tender.
Whisk the cornstarch with cold water and stir it in. Add the broccoli, cover, and cook on high for 25–35 minutes, until crisp-tender and the sauce thickens.
Garnish with sesame seeds, if using, and serve over rice.
recipes.description: Tender sliced beef and broccoli coated in a glossy garlic-soy sauce for serving over rice.

recipes.name: Korean-Inspired BBQ Beef

ingredients.item: boneless beef chuck roast, cut into 3 or 4 pieces

instructions: Place the beef in the slow cooker.
Whisk the soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, vinegar, garlic, ginger, gochujang sauce, and broth. Pour over the beef.
Cover and cook on low for 8–9 hours or high for 5–6 hours, until fork-tender.
Shred the beef, discard excess fat, and stir the meat into the sauce.
Serve over rice or noodles and garnish with green onions, if desired.
recipes.description: Chuck roast slowly cooked in a sweet-savory soy, garlic, ginger, and gochujang sauce until easy to shred.

recipes.name: French Dip Sandwiches
instructions: Place the onion and garlic in the slow cooker and set the roast on top.
Add the broth, Worcestershire, soy sauce, thyme, and black pepper.
Cover and cook on low for 8–10 hours or high for 5–6 hours, until the beef shreds easily.
Shred the beef and return it to the juices for 10 minutes.
Fill toasted rolls with beef and provolone. Strain the cooking liquid and serve it alongside for dipping.
recipes.description: Slow-cooked beef piled onto toasted rolls with melted provolone and rich au jus for dipping.

recipes.name: Slow Cooker Cheesesteak Sandwiches

ingredients.item: beef sirloin or chuck, thinly sliced

instructions: Place the beef, onions, peppers, and garlic in the slow cooker.
Add the broth, Worcestershire, and burger seasoning and toss gently.
Cover and cook on low for 5–6 hours or high for 3–4 hours, until the beef is tender.
Drain each portion lightly and pile it into a toasted roll.
Top with provolone and broil briefly, watching closely, until melted.
recipes.description: Thin beef, onions, and peppers cooked until tender and finished on toasted rolls with melted provolone.

recipes.name: Smoky Ranch Beef and Peppers
instructions: Place the onion, peppers, and garlic in the slow cooker and set the roast on top.
Whisk the broth, tomato paste, Worcestershire, ranch seasoning, smoked paprika, and black pepper. Pour over the roast.
Cover and cook on low for 8–9 hours or high for 5–6 hours, until fork-tender.
Shred the beef and stir it through the vegetables and sauce.
Serve over potatoes, rice, noodles, or toasted rolls.
recipes.description: An original shredded-beef dinner combining ranch herbs, smoked paprika, peppers, and a savory tomato-beef sauce.

recipes.name: Classic BBQ Pulled Pork
instructions: Place the onion in the slow cooker. Coat the pork with the rib rub and set it on top.
Whisk the barbecue sauce, broth, vinegar, and Worcestershire and pour around the pork.
Cover and cook on low for 8–10 hours or high for 5–6 hours, until the pork reaches at least 195°F and shreds easily.
Remove excess fat, shred the pork, and stir it into enough sauce to coat.
Serve on buns or with your preferred sides.
recipes.description: Pork shoulder slowly cooked with onion and a tangy barbecue sauce until tender enough to pile onto sandwiches.

recipes.name: Pork Chops with Onion Gravy
instructions: Arrange the onion and mushrooms, if using, in the slow cooker and place the pork chops on top.
Add the broth, Worcestershire, poultry seasoning, and pepper.
Cover and cook on low for 5–6 hours or high for 3–4 hours, until tender and the pork reaches at least 145°F.
Transfer the chops to a plate. Whisk the cornstarch with cold water and stir it into the liquid.
Cook on high for 10–15 minutes, until thickened, then return the chops to the gravy.
recipes.description: Tender pork chops slowly cooked with onions, mushrooms, and a savory homemade-style gravy.

recipes.name: Apple-Butter Pork Loin
instructions: Season the pork loin with salt and pepper and place it in the slow cooker.
Whisk the apple butter, Dijon, vinegar, garlic, thyme, cinnamon, and broth. Pour over the pork.
Cover and cook on low for 4–6 hours, checking early, until the center reaches 145°F.
Transfer the pork to a cutting board and rest for 10 minutes.
Slice and spoon the apple-butter sauce over the top.
recipes.description: An original sweet-savory pork loin glazed with apple butter, Dijon, garlic, and warm herbs.

recipes.name: Kielbasa, Sauerkraut, and Potatoes
instructions: Place the potatoes and onion in the slow cooker. Add the sauerkraut and apple, if using.
Arrange the kielbasa over the top.
Whisk the broth, mustard, brown sugar, and pepper and pour into the cooker.
Cover and cook on low for 6–7 hours or high for 3–4 hours, until the potatoes are tender and the sausage reaches 160°F.
Stir gently before serving.
recipes.description: Smoky kielbasa, tender potatoes, sauerkraut, and onion slowly cooked with mustard and apple.

recipes.name: Sausage, Potatoes, and Green Beans
instructions: Place the potatoes and onion in the slow cooker and season with half of the Creole-style seasoning.
Add the sausage, green beans, broth, butter, remaining seasoning, and black pepper.
Cover and cook on low for 6–7 hours or high for 3–4 hours, until the potatoes and beans are tender and the sausage reaches 160°F.
Stir gently and taste before adding any additional salt.
recipes.description: A simple one-pot meal of smoked sausage, tender potatoes, green beans, onion, and savory seasoning.

recipes.name: Chicken and Stuffing

ingredients.item: boneless skinless chicken breasts or thighs

instructions: Season the chicken with salt and pepper and arrange it in the slow cooker.
Whisk the soup, sour cream, ½ cup broth, and poultry seasoning and spread over the chicken.
Toss the stuffing mix with the remaining broth and spread it evenly over the sauce.
Cover and cook on low for 4–6 hours or high for 2½–3½ hours, until the chicken reaches 165°F.
Let stand uncovered for 10 minutes before serving.
recipes.description: Tender chicken baked slowly beneath a creamy, savory stuffing layer for an easy comfort-food dinner.

recipes.name: Creamy White Chicken Chili

ingredients.item: boneless skinless chicken breasts or thighs
great northern or cannellini beans, drained

instructions: Place the chicken, beans, corn, green chiles, onion, broth, cumin, garlic powder, onion powder, and oregano in the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on low for 5–6 hours or high for 3–4 hours, until the chicken reaches 165°F.
Remove and shred the chicken, then return it to the cooker.
Stir in the cream cheese, Monterey Jack, and sour cream. Cover and cook on high for 15–20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until smooth.
Taste and adjust the seasoning before serving.
recipes.description: Chicken, white beans, corn, and green chiles slowly cooked with cumin and finished with a creamy, cheesy base.

recipes.name: Creamy Chicken Tacos

ingredients.item: boneless skinless chicken breasts or thighs

instructions: Place the chicken in the slow cooker and sprinkle with taco seasoning, if using.
Pour the salsa over the chicken.
Cover and cook on low for 4–6 hours or high for 2½–3½ hours, until the chicken reaches 165°F.
Shred the chicken, add the cream cheese, and stir until smooth. Cover for 10 minutes if needed to finish melting.
Serve in tortillas, over rice, or in bowls.
recipes.description: Three-ingredient salsa chicken cooked until shreddable, then finished with cream cheese for tacos and rice bowls.

recipes.name: Honey Garlic Chicken
instructions: Arrange the chicken in the slow cooker.
Whisk the honey, soy sauce, ketchup, garlic, ginger, and vinegar and pour over the chicken.
Cover and cook on low for 4–5 hours or high for 2½–3 hours, until the chicken reaches 165°F.
Transfer the chicken to a plate. Stir together the cornstarch and cold water and whisk it into the sauce.
Cook on high for 10–15 minutes, until thickened, then return the chicken and turn to coat.
recipes.description: Tender chicken coated in a sweet-savory soy, honey, garlic, and ginger sauce.

recipes.name: Chicken and Drop Dumplings
instructions: Place the chicken, onion, carrots, celery, broth, poultry seasoning, and pepper in the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on low for 6–7 hours or high for 3½–4 hours, until the chicken reaches 165°F. Shred the chicken in the cooker.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, and salt. Cut in the butter, then stir in the buttermilk just until a soft dough forms.
Set the cooker to high. Drop heaping tablespoons of dough over the simmering stew, leaving space between them.
Cover and cook for 45–60 minutes without lifting the lid, until the dumplings are cooked through and no raw dough remains.
recipes.description: A comforting chicken stew with vegetables, herbs, and tender buttermilk drop dumplings.

recipes.name: Classic Chicken Noodle Soup

ingredients.item: boneless skinless chicken thighs or breasts

instructions: Place the chicken, onion, carrots, celery, garlic, broth, thyme, parsley, bay leaf, salt, and pepper in the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on low for 6–7 hours or high for 3–4 hours, until the chicken reaches 165°F.
Remove the chicken, shred it, and return it to the cooker. Discard the bay leaf.
Set the cooker to high, stir in the noodles, and cook for 15–30 minutes, until tender.
Serve promptly so the noodles do not continue absorbing the broth.
recipes.description: Chicken, carrots, celery, onion, herbs, and egg noodles in a clear, comforting broth.

recipes.name: Lemon-Herb Chicken and Potatoes
instructions: Place the potatoes and onion in the slow cooker.
Season the chicken with salt, pepper, and Italian seasoning and arrange it over the potatoes.
Add the garlic, broth, lemon zest, and lemon juice.
Cover and cook on low for 5–6 hours or high for 3–4 hours, until the chicken reaches 165°F and the potatoes are tender.
For browned skin, transfer bone-in thighs to a baking sheet and broil briefly, watching closely.
recipes.description: Chicken and baby potatoes slowly cooked with garlic, lemon, broth, and Italian herbs.

recipes.name: Garlic-Parmesan Chicken and Potatoes
instructions: Place the potatoes in the slow cooker and arrange the chicken over them.
Add the broth, garlic-herb seasoning, garlic, and black pepper.
Cover and cook on low for 5–6 hours or high for 3–4 hours, until the chicken reaches 165°F and the potatoes are tender.
Stir in the cream and Parmesan. Add the spinach, if using.
Cover and cook on high for 15–20 minutes, until the sauce is smooth and the spinach wilts.
recipes.description: An original creamy garlic-Parmesan chicken and potato dinner finished with spinach and a spoonable sauce.

recipes.name: Maple-Dijon Chicken with Sweet Potatoes

ingredients.item: sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1-inch pieces

instructions: Place the sweet potatoes in the slow cooker and arrange the chicken over them.
Whisk the maple syrup, Dijon, broth, vinegar, garlic, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Pour the sauce over the chicken and potatoes.
Cover and cook on low for 5–6 hours or high for 3–4 hours, until the chicken reaches 165°F and the sweet potatoes are tender.
Spoon the sauce over each serving.
recipes.description: An original sweet-savory combination of chicken, sweet potatoes, maple syrup, Dijon, thyme, and garlic.

recipes.name: Slow Cooker Lazy Lasagna
instructions: Brown the meat and onion in a skillet until the meat reaches 160°F. Drain excess grease and stir in the Italian seasoning.
Spread 1 cup sauce in the slow cooker. Layer half the frozen ravioli, half the meat, 1 cup mozzarella, and more sauce.
Repeat the layers and finish with the remaining sauce and mozzarella. Sprinkle with Parmesan.
Cover and cook on low for 3½–4½ hours, until the ravioli are tender and the center reaches 165°F.
Turn off the cooker and rest for 15 minutes before serving.
recipes.description: An easy layered lasagna made with cheese ravioli, meat sauce, mozzarella, and Parmesan.

recipes.name: Slow Cooker Baked Ziti
instructions: Brown the meat and onion until the meat reaches 160°F. Drain and stir in the Italian seasoning.
Combine the meat, sauce, water, and dry pasta in the slow cooker, making sure the pasta is mostly submerged.
Cover and cook on low for 2–3 hours, stirring after 1 hour, until the pasta is barely tender.
Dollop ricotta over the pasta and top with mozzarella and Parmesan.
Cover and cook for 20–30 minutes more, until the cheese melts and the center reaches 165°F.
recipes.description: Ziti, seasoned meat sauce, ricotta, mozzarella, and Parmesan cooked together into a hearty pasta casserole.

recipes.name: Creamy Tomato Beef Tortellini
instructions: Brown the beef and onion until the beef reaches 160°F. Drain well.
Add the beef, garlic, sauce, broth, and Italian seasoning to the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on low for 4–5 hours or high for 2–3 hours.
Stir in the tortellini and cook on high for 20–30 minutes, until tender.
Stir in the cream and Parmesan and cook for 10 minutes more, until smooth and hot.
recipes.description: An original slow-cooker dinner of seasoned beef, cheese tortellini, tomato sauce, cream, and Parmesan.

recipes.name: Loaded Baked Potato Soup
instructions: Place the potatoes, onion, broth, garlic powder, salt, and pepper in the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on low for 6–7 hours or high for 3–4 hours, until the potatoes are very tender.
Mash some of the potatoes in the cooker, leaving the rest chunky.
Stir in the milk, cheddar, sour cream, and half the bacon. Cook on high for 15–20 minutes, until hot and creamy.
Serve topped with the remaining bacon and green onions.
recipes.description: A thick, creamy potato soup finished with cheddar, sour cream, bacon, and green onions.

recipes.name: Broccoli Cheddar Soup
instructions: Place the broccoli, carrots, onion, broth, garlic powder, salt, and pepper in the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on low for 4–5 hours or high for 2–3 hours, until the vegetables are tender.
Blend a portion of the soup with an immersion blender, leaving some texture.
Whisk the cornstarch with cold water and stir it in with the half-and-half. Cook on high for 15 minutes.
Reduce to warm and gradually stir in the cheddar until melted; do not boil after adding the cheese.
recipes.description: Tender broccoli and carrots in a creamy cheddar soup with a smooth, comforting finish.

recipes.name: Ham and White Bean Soup

ingredients.item: great northern beans, drained and rinsed
meaty ham bone or 4 cups diced cooked ham

instructions: Add the beans, ham, onion, carrots, celery, garlic, broth, thyme, bay leaf, and pepper to the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on low for 6–8 hours or high for 3–4 hours, until the vegetables are tender and the flavors have developed.
Remove the ham bone. Shred any meat and return it to the soup; discard the bone and bay leaf.
Taste before adding salt because the ham and broth may already be salty.
Mash a small portion of the beans into the broth if you prefer a thicker soup.
recipes.description: A hearty soup of ham, white beans, vegetables, broth, and herbs slowly cooked until rich and tender.

recipes.name: Vegetable Beef Soup
instructions: Brown the beef in oil in batches and transfer it to the slow cooker.
Add the onion, carrots, celery, potatoes, green beans, corn, tomatoes, broth, tomato paste, thyme, parsley, bay leaf, salt, and pepper.
Cover and cook on low for 7–9 hours or high for 4–5 hours, until the beef and potatoes are tender.
Discard the bay leaf, taste, and adjust the seasoning before serving.
recipes.description: Tender beef, potatoes, mixed vegetables, tomatoes, and herbs simmered into a satisfying family soup.

recipes.name: Gochujang-Honey Pulled Pork
instructions: Place the pork in the slow cooker.
Whisk the gochujang sauce, honey, soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, ginger, and broth. Pour over the pork.
Cover and cook on low for 8–10 hours or high for 5–6 hours, until the pork reaches at least 195°F and shreds easily.
Remove excess fat, shred the pork, and stir it into the sauce.
Serve in rice bowls, tacos, lettuce wraps, or sandwiches and garnish with green onions, if desired.
recipes.description: An original pulled pork with gochujang, honey, soy, garlic, ginger, and vinegar for bowls, tacos, or sandwiches.
